name: Hollowground — Communal Dream Space Network
description: Hollowground operates a network of licensed communal dream-sharing lounges in Tier 2 and 3 districts, where groups of four to twelve participants enter a loosely structured shared BCI dreamspace moderated by a human facilitator called a Weaver. Unlike competitive neural environments, Hollowground sessions are deliberately unscripted — the collective unconscious of the group shapes the architecture, and participants often report encountering imagery drawn from other users' genuine memories blending with their own. Sessions last two to six hours and are intensely social, generating a subculture of regular groups who call themselves Hollows.
story_hooks: A Hollow regular begins seeing the same recurring figure in every session — a woman who doesn't match any other participant's profile and who seems to be actively searching for something
A corporate fixer infiltrates a Hollowground session to extract proprietary memory fragments from a former Axiom engineer who has taken refuge in the dream-sharing community
A Weaver discovers that one of their regular group is a Tier 5 executive slumming anonymously — and that the executive's leaked dream imagery contains evidence of a major corponation atrocity
